articles.summary: Hazeena Mazood joined a small office in Dubai in 1996, when the company's presence in the region was just taking shape. Three decades later, she reflects on what a career spanning sales, quality, supply chain, HSE, compliance, and commercial operations taught her about adaptability, trust, and growing alongside a global company.
articles.title: Three lessons from one of Tenaris Middle East's earliest employees

articles.summary: When Alejandro Colicchio first walked into a Tenaris mill in 1993, his son Martín wasn't born yet. More than thirty years later, the two work at the same Tenaris plant in Sault Ste. Marie, Canada: Alejandro, in rolling mill operations; Martín, in maintenance. They carry with them a family story that began long before either of them: Alejandro's own father was a rolling mill manager in the Argentine steel industry.
articles.title: A father and son working at Tenaris in Canada share their steel family’s story

articles.summary: For Alix Aké Kob, Heat Treatment Specialist at Tenaris’s industrial center in Veracruz, Mexico, five years at the company already feels like a journey across processes, plants and perspectives. Her story is a reminder that, even early in a career, the steel industry can open doors to global learning, exposure to a variety of operations and the chance to lead.
articles.title: Driven by curiosity: a Heat Treatment Specialist's first five years at Tenaris

articles.summary: Tenaris announced on July 20, 2026, that it will donate $50,000 toward the construction of the Aquatics Center of Matagorda County. The Aquatics Center represents an important step in the county's long-term vision to enhance wellness and recreational opportunities for residents.
articles.title: Tenaris contributes to the construction of the Aquatics Center of Matagorda County

articles.summary: At the beginning of June, representatives from PETRONAS Canada (Petronas) became the first customers to visit Tenaris’s Fort St. John Service Centre since opening at the end of 2025.
articles.title: First customer visit marks milestone for Fort St. John Service Centre

articles.summary: Tenaris has completed the installation of two new photovoltaic plants at its Sabbio Bergamasco and Arcore facilities in Italy, further contributing towards Tenaris’s target to reduce CO₂ emissions by 30% by 2030, compared to 2018 levels.
articles.title: Tenaris expands renewable energy production in Europe with two photovoltaic plants in Italy
